policy: Visible long hair curtain is in front of the far stick/arm where overlap occurs. Occluded stick/arm portions are deliberately invisible, not forced into front. Entirely hidden joints are excluded from visual quality judgement per user20261008. Original right-hand/stick region is excluded so no extra hand is restored. Kit original immutable. Foreground hair is restricted below y350 so it never slices the foreground ride cymbal.
scope: Only source-bound updated canonical frames and Neutral; legacy unvalidated sprites are not overlaid with a differently registered hair curtain.
